page: Amazon Web Services gr6.4xlarge is a graphics-intensive server instance powered by the AWS Nitro hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture with an AMD EPYC 7R13 processor operating at 3.4 GHz. This processor provides 16 dedicated vCPUs across 8 physical cores with multithreading enabled. The system is equipped with 128.0 GB of DDR4 memory running at 3 GHz, establishing a one-to-eight vCPU-to-memory ratio.

For hardware acceleration, the instance bundles a single NVIDIA Ada Lovelace L4 GPU with 22 GB of dedicated VRAM. Local storage is provided via a 600 GB NVMe SSD. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 10 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates strong single-core CPU performance, placing in the top 25% in stress-ng testing, while multi-core CPU performance and memory read bandwidth fall within the average range. Large block memory write bandwidth is a relative bottleneck, scoring in the bottom 25%. However, the integrated NVIDIA L4 GPU delivers exceptional performance for machine learning workloads, with LLM inference speeds for both small and medium models ranking in the top 10% for prompt processing and text generation.

Given the inclusion of a dedicated Ada Lovelace GPU, high memory density, and local NVMe storage, this instance offers a resource-dense profile for workloads requiring both graphics acceleration and substantial memory capacity. It is highly suitable for LLM inference, graphics-intensive rendering, machine learning model deployment, and database operations that benefit from local NVMe caching.
